Vendored hashing binaries: hash-wasm 4.12.0

Official repository: https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm
Exact package: https://registry.npmjs.org/hash-wasm/-/hash-wasm-4.12.0.tgz
Package integrity:
sha512-+/2B2rYLb48I/evdOIhP+K/DD2ca2fgBjp6O+GBEnCDk2e4rpeXIK8GvIyRPjTezgmWn9gmKwkQjjx6BtqDHVQ==

The files are the unchanged base64-decoded data fields in the exact package's
dist/xxhash128.umd.min.js and dist/blake3.umd.min.js. No primitive was rewritten.
xxhash128 is upstream XXH3-128, with a zero 64-bit seed and canonical big-endian
128-bit output. BLAKE3 uses standard unkeyed tree hashing and 32-byte output.

xxhash128.wasm: 10302 bytes
blake3.wasm: 11891 bytes
manifest.json pins byte counts, original SHA-256 provenance and SHA-512.
The production adapter requires SHA-512 validation before instantiation.
The obsolete XXH64 WASM asset is removed; no alias reports XXH64 as XXH3-128.

Reproduce/verify after npm ci --ignore-scripts:
node scripts/check-extended-hash-assets.js
node scripts/check-extended-hash-assets.js --write
--write reproduces only the exact pinned bytes. An upstream upgrade requires
review of source, licenses, checksums and vectors.

Upstream sources: src/xxhash128.c, src/blake3.c, src/hash-wasm.h,
lib/xxhash128.ts, lib/blake3.ts, lib/WASMInterface.ts.
See LICENSE.txt, CC0-1.0.txt and UPSTREAM-LICENSES.txt.

The local synchronous Node adapter resets each instance, consumes 16-KiB input
chunks, copies out canonical output, then wipes its input/output buffer and
exported hash state. WASM imports no host functions. Production needs no native
addons, package installation, network or runtime code download for these hashes.

Standard keyed, derive-key, XOF and incremental BLAKE3 use the pinned unmodified
noble-hashes-1.8.0 dependency closure beside this directory. Its ordinary BLAKE3
tree semantics are unchanged. Server derivation contexts are purpose-specific,
and private material is not embedded in this source or in client executable code.
